product_constraint: Same-workload real API MTP d2/d3 committed Decode 1.5x to 3x non-MTP, with exact target state/logits and joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total reporting.

downward_budget.scope: The old attribution is an opportunity ceiling, not a current v31 profile or projected gain. QK alone cannot close the 40K gap.

hypothesis: A zero-start 8-product reduction may be order-independent when its entire signed subset-sum lattice is exactly FP32 representable. This differs from the rejected MMA carry-in substitution and approximate publication certificates.

host_predicate.operands: Finite normal BF16 or zero; eight original lane offsets 0,128,64,192,32,160,96,224.
host_predicate.calculation: Represent each nonzero exact product as odd positive integer magnitude times 2^e. At common minimum exponent e0, sum absolute integer magnitudes A. Admit only e0 >= -126, A <= 2^24-1 and e0+floor(log2(A)) <= 127. All-zero groups are separately admissible with positive-zero normalization.
host_predicate.proof_scope: Every signed subset sum has magnitude <= A in the same lattice; all intermediate exact sums therefore fit normal FP32 or zero. This proves order-independent scalar arithmetic under the predicate. It does not by itself prove undocumented native MMA product behavior, fragment correctness, or a useful GPU executor.
host_predicate.oracle: Compare the original explicit balanced FP32 tree against independently reconstructed exact integer sum for every admitted sample; directed exponent/exception controls fail closed. Original 32-lane tree and final scale would stay unchanged.

payload.sampling: 32 disjoint eight-position tiles, starts floor(i*(40000-8)/31), all four KV heads, six query heads and 32 original lane groups; fixed before viewing results.
payload.authority: Authenticated historical real first-step Legacy-Prefill inputs, not current corrected-Prefill/MTP query distribution. A favorable historical screen must obtain a current MTP capture before any implementation selection. A negative result closes only this proposed broad-cooperative admission, not all QK acceleration.

selection.cooperative_unit: One original lane subgroup across six query heads and eight key positions (48 output cells). A uniform exact-only native matrix operation needs all useful cells admitted; per-cell repair would be a separate architecture and is not opened here.
selection.proceed_floor: At least 50% cooperative units admitted across the fixed panel, plus zero admitted scalar-oracle mismatches. This is a feasibility floor, not a speedup threshold; guard/feed/repair costs are not measured.
selection.bound: One host assessment. Below floor, archive with no GPU or parameter scan. Above floor, first bind current corrected-Prefill/MTP payload and a separate exact native-instruction proof, then declare one composed executor with immediate same P65/8K/40K d2 API return; useful direction unlocks d3.
selection.forbidden: No numerical tolerance change, production mutation, runtime guard/repair kernel, GPU timing or profiler within this host package.

rollback_boundary: Host-only new assessment; retained v31 source and installed production remain untouched.
